page.layout: One page of text, one column of running text; a catchword-free page ending in a centred word "FINIS." below; no margin notes.

main_text.p: dum, etiam de iis, quæ ne quidem vulgus cogitat. Exspectares forsan, longiorem Meisneri, Scheibleri, & inprimis Calo-vii inter Lutheranos; Suarezii, Conim-bricenfium, aliorumque inter Iesuitas refutationem; Sed elenchtica prolixiora inter didactica tradere non duxi consul-tum; & magis quoniam Exercitationes Metaphysicas, si Deo ita visum, brevi adornabo, quibus inter alia hoc præstabo, ut Maccovium, Timplerum, Keckermannum, Burgersdicium, a'iosque Reformatæ Religionis Metaphysicos ab eorum injuriis vindicem. Hæ si tibi gratæ videantur, unâ precare mecum Ἀρχιφιλόσοφον, ut conatus meos alina sua benedictione largiter velit promovere; ad sui nominis gloriam, ac animarum nostrarum salutem. Vale.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: The marginal dot before "adornabo" is a reference mark, not a word. The Greek word is printed as Ἀρχιφιλόσοφον (approximate reading). The word "alinā" is read as "alina" with a superscript mark, doubtful. Faint stains and a small mark near the bottom centre are not printed text.
